zh.title: 航空短訊彙整：法國IRIS軍用觀測衛星將在軌飛行接替CSO，空中巴士主導逾15億歐元計畫；波音民航部門裁員約2500人，737MAX與787增產放緩
zh.summary: 本期收錄2則獨立消息：法國IRIS軍用觀測衛星將在軌飛行接替CSO，空中巴士主導逾15億歐元計畫、波音民航部門裁員約2500人，737MAX與787增產放緩。
body: 本期彙整2則航空短訊，各則為獨立事件。部分內容摘自近期站內報導，原文與來源見文末。

1. 法國IRIS軍用觀測衛星將在軌飛行接替CSO，空中巴士主導逾15億歐元計畫
法國國防採購局已將IRIS計畫授予約空中巴士防務與航太與泰雷茲阿萊尼亞航太，由兩顆新一代極高解析度地球觀測衛星接替CSO系統，確保法軍太空影像情報能力；整體合約金額逾15億歐元，執行至2030年代末。

2. 波音民航部門裁員約2500人，737MAX與787增產放緩
波音宣布民航部門將裁減約5%人力、約2500個職位，透過非自願裁員與自然流失進行，11月不裁員、12月起發出裁員通知；主因是工廠與供應鏈挑戰迫使737MAX與787放慢增產步伐。

en.title: Aviation briefs: Airbus to Deliver IRIS, France's Next-Generation Military Earth Observation Satellites; Boeing to Cut About 2,500 Commercial Airplanes Jobs as Production Ramp-Up Slows
en.summary: 2 independent updates: Airbus to Deliver IRIS, France's Next-Generation Military Earth Observation Satellites; Boeing to Cut About 2,500 Commercial Airplanes Jobs as Production Ramp-Up Slows.
body: 2 independent aviation updates. Includes excerpts of recent reports, with original reports and sources linked below.

1. Airbus to Deliver IRIS, France's Next-Generation Military Earth Observation Satellites
France's defence procurement agency has awarded the IRIS programme to Airbus Defence and Space and Thales Alenia Space, with two next-generation very high-resolution Earth observation satellites replacing the CSO system to secure French military space imagery; the contract is worth more than 1.5 billion euros and runs to the end of the 2030s.

2. Boeing to Cut About 2,500 Commercial Airplanes Jobs as Production Ramp-Up Slows
Boeing will cut about 5% of its Commercial Airplanes workforce, around 2,500 jobs, through involuntary layoffs and natural attrition, with layoff notifications starting in December; the move follows slower production increases for the 737 MAX and 787 amid factory and supply-chain challenges.
